fixture.addedFixture: 1000 copies of snapshot gulpfile.js in benchmark-1000

method: One fresh process per binary, one initial and one repeated archive download, sequential loopback runs. Peak RSS sampled every 20 ms during repeated request; includes worker processes, excludes MongoDB, Redis and benchmark client. No profiler attached. Filesystem caches were not dropped. Timing is indicative, not a multi-run statistical estimate.
changes: Default MongoDB wire compression changed from zstd to Snappy; explicit URI compressor settings respected
Projected MongoDB cursor with 128-entry batches; removed silent 100000-file truncation
One 32 KiB copy buffer reused per ZIP

validation.raceTests: ZIP streaming/cancellation, multi-batch archive contents and exclusions, second-provider lifecycle: passed (302.324s server package)

limitations: ZIP central directory and duplicate-name set still scale with entry count
Individual transformation workers still have their existing input and memory limits
Explicitly configuring zstd in the MongoDB URI can reintroduce its encoder memory costs
